scope: Public baseline reproduction contract audit; no new toy hypothesis or architecture
formal_findings: The 131072-frame experiments are short-horizon screening runs, not a numerical reproduction of the official public SILG RTFM baseline.
Stateful=true is not the official RTFM launch setting; the official launcher fixes stateful=false.
Actors=2, batch_size=2 and num_threads=1 differ from the official parser defaults 30, 24 and 4.
No prior 131072-frame negative result may be used to conclude that the official recurrent baseline itself fails to reproduce.
The prior results remain valid only as negative evidence for the explicitly recorded short-horizon screening contracts.
minimum_next_actions: Relabel all existing 131072-frame runs as screening evidence, not public reproduction attempts.
Preserve official job.tar checkpoints fail-closed in the next training run, including model, optimizer, scheduler, frame counter, bytes and SHA-256.

Use the official launch contract as the reproduction target: model=multi, stateful=false, unroll=80, batch=24, actors=30, threads=4, total_frames=100000000, with entropy 0.05 and 0.005 and fixed seeds.

Before consuming the full horizon, perform only an infrastructure qualification run that proves checkpoint/resume equivalence and resource feasibility; do not treat that qualification as capability evidence.
If the available runner cannot execute the official contract, preserve a reproducible resource-blocker log and do not substitute a reduced contract while calling it reproduction.
